gene_id.description: Ensembl gene ID including its version suffix. The _key of this record is the same ID with the version removed.

gene_type.description: Biotype GENCODE assigns to the gene.

chr.description: Chromosome the gene lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

start.description: Start of the gene, 0-based and inclusive.

end.description: End of the gene, 0-based and exclusive.

strand.description: Strand the gene is transcribed from: '+' for the forward strand, '-' for the reverse strand.

symbol.description: GENCODE gene symbol. Carries the same value as name.

version.description: GENCODE release the annotation was taken from.

study_sets.description: IGVF study sets that include this gene. Always null for mouse genes, because the portal only reports study sets for human genes.

collections.description: Curated gene collections that include this gene. Always null for mouse genes, because the portal only reports collections for human genes.

version_number.description: Version suffix of the Ensembl gene ID.

mgi.description: MGI ID for the gene, taken from the GENCODE annotation where present, otherwise resolved through the NCBI gene info file.

synonyms.description: Alternative symbols and names for the gene, gathered from the NCBI gene info file: its synonyms, other designations, and nomenclature-authority symbol and full name.

entrez.description: Entrez gene ID for the gene, prefixed with 'ENTREZ:'.

accessible_via.return: _id, chr, start, end, gene_id, mgi, entrez, name, gene_type, source, version, source_url, organism
